lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines of high contrast; spacing is non-uniform, wider in the central torso region (approx. 40-50 pixels) than the posterior (approx. 20-25 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the second line from the posterior near the dorsal ridge; a secondary merging point is visible on the fifth line from the posterior at the mid-lateral torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 4 and Line 10 from the posterior show vertical truncation before reaching the ventral margin; Line 8 presents as a broken, two-part dashed segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots clustered on the lateral posterior haunch; density is approximately one spot per 1200 square pixels in this region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-thigh show horizontal spatial alignment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the ocular regions; distinct white horizontal patch on the anterior neck/throat area; white interior fringe on the pinnae.
